\#define\ APNAP\(playervar,\ \.\.\.\)\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	do\ \{\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	int\ playervar;\ int\ macro_apnap;\	/\*\ avoid\ comma\ \*/\	\	\\\
\	\	for\ \(macro_apnap\ =\ 0;\ macro_apnap\ <=\ 1;\ \+\+macro_apnap\)\{\	\\\
\	\	\	playervar\ =\ current_turn\ \^\ macro_apnap;\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\	\{__VA_ARGS__;\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\}\ while\ \(0\)

scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:37 definitions updated and63 retained. Restore attack, ETB and spell dispatch, aura events, characteristic power/toughness, Storm queries, double-X payment, Generator Servant mana/haste bookkeeping, target cleanup and native damage helpers. Native quirks retained, including Body Double cancellation state and original target/owner restrictions. Original source names/interfaces are preserved. Full aligned owner/callee assembly and DWARF resolve radiant_damage additional_flags0 and prowl trailing color0 optimized arguments; original full source APIs remain. Exact option-array copy bytes are pinned.134 native callee identities,113 enum values,6 complete source dependency bodies and79 data ranges are bound. Independent callees and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
